entities.summary: Laco Novomeský was a Slovak poet, writer and communist politician. Novomeský was a member of the DAV group; after World War II he was the commissioner of education and culture of the Czechoslovak Socialist Republic. A prominent Czechoslovak politician, he was persecuted in the 1950s and later rehabilitated in the 1960s.

entities.summary: Laco Novomeský was a Slovak poet, writer and communist politician. Novomeský was a member of the DAV group; after World War II he was the commissioner of education and culture of the Czechoslovak Socialist Republic. A prominent Czechoslovak politician, he was persecuted in the 1950s and later rehabilitated in the 1960s.
